channel.title: accha? daily
channel.description: The day's biggest stories, explained simply.

item.title: Zomato's 'Limitless Delivery' lets you order from restaurants up to 40 km away in 7 cities
item.description: Zomato (Eternal) has switched on a feature that stretches delivery range to as far as 40 km within a city, so restaurants that were out of reach can now show up on your app.

item.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas by mid-2027, Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk says Tesla will free up its Texas factory space for the Cybercab robotaxi, ending production of the stainless-steel pickup next year.

item.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends food licences of 105 outlets, including Blinkit and Zepto units in Mumbai
item.description: A pre-Diwali inspection drive on 4 and 5 November found hygiene lapses across the state. The suspension list names Blink Commerce Pvt Ltd and Zepto Ltd, both in Mumbai.

item.title: OpenAI reportedly closes $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below the $1.4 trillion it first sought
item.description: Bloomberg reports that the ChatGPT maker has received the first part of a new round, with SoftBank and MGX among the investors, after the AI-stock sell-off forced it to scale back.

item.title: Mamaearth parent Honasa's Q2 profit jumps 87% to ₹73 crore as revenue grows 36%
item.description: Honasa Consumer posted a profit of about ₹73 crore for July–September, up from about ₹39 crore a year ago, though profit and revenue slipped from the June quarter.

item.title: Angel One overtakes Zerodha as India's No. 2 broker with 69.98 lakh active clients
item.description: NSE data for October shows Angel One adding 2.43 lakh active clients while Zerodha lost 32,435, flipping the order behind Groww.

item.title: MakeMyTrip buys a majority stake in ride-pooling app Quick Ride
item.description: The travel giant enters shared mobility for an undisclosed sum. Quick Ride's pooling business moves into a new company with its promoters still running it.

item.title: EloElo raises $80 million from Hornbill and NBCUniversal to take microdrama app Story TV global
item.description: The Bengaluru group behind Story TV says the Series C takes its total funding to $130 million.

item.title: Jewellery brand GIVA raises over $100 million (about ₹975 crore) led by Multiples
item.description: The Bengaluru brand plans to grow from 400-plus stores to over 1,000 outlets in three to five years.

item.title: Shiprocket swings to a profit in Q2 as revenue rises 35% to ₹674 crore
item.description: The logistics-tech firm made about ₹60 lakh in profit against a ₹20.3 crore loss a year ago, and is now debt-free after its IPO.

item.title: Cabinet approves ₹2,814 crore scheme to boost lithium and nickel processing in India
item.description: A 30% capital subsidy will back four processing plants as the government tries to cut its dependence on imported refined minerals.

item.title: Money deadlines this month: ITR date for audit cases is 21 Nov, pensioners have until 30 Nov
item.description: A quick list of what changed from 1 November, from tax filing dates to credit card fees at one public-sector bank.

item.title: Iran's Guards say tankers hit mines near Hormuz; Brent slips below $100 as talks continue
item.description: Maritime officials have not confirmed the Guards' claims, while mediators work on a US-Iran proposal.

item.title: US to mediate Russia–Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November, with low hopes
item.description: The working-level round is the first direct negotiation between the two sides in about nine months.

item.title: COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye: nearly 200 countries, leaders' summit on 11–12 November
item.description: The UN climate summit runs to 20 November, with the 1.5°C goal under heavy pressure.

item.title: US midterms: Democrats win both the House and the Senate, networks call
item.description: Counts are still being finalised. AP tallies cited by Yahoo News show Democrats around 254 House seats and 54 Senate seats.

item.title: IndiaAI Mission releases three homegrown models: EKA-1 and Dhīr 2B and 5B
item.description: EKA-1 from Soket Labs covers all 22 scheduled Indian languages; ZenteiQ's two smaller Dhīr models are open source.

item.title: Apple CEO John Ternus is pushing software chief Craig Federighi to speed up AI, Bloomberg reports
item.description: Mark Gurman says Ternus is frustrated that Apple seems less urgent about AI than its rivals.

item.title: Muhurat trading ends in the red for the first time in nine years: Sensex 80,999, Nifty 24,986
item.description: The one-hour Diwali session on Sunday followed a seven-day rally; smallcaps bucked the trend.

item.title: Bosch approves a 1:5 split and a 3:1 bonus, so every share becomes 20
item.description: The board announced the two moves with its Q2 results on 6 November; both need shareholder approval.

item.title: Norris wins a wet Brazilian GP after Antonelli spins from the lead; Mercedes clinch constructors' title
item.description: Verstappen was second and Hadjar third. Antonelli's lead over Verstappen is 111 points with 75 left.

item.title: Man Utd come from two down twice to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa as Dorgu levels in the 96th minute
item.description: United are still in the relegation zone on 8 points from 10 games.

item.title: Chennai Open final between Janice Tjen and Magda Linette moved to Monday after rain and poor air
item.description: Top seed and defending champion Tjen faces Linette at 11 a.m. today.

item.title: ECB braces for a loss of up to £50 million in 2027 with no India series at home
item.description: Even with the Ashes at home, the board expects a big swing from the £12.6 million profit it made in 2025.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1's Diwali weekend: trackers put it at ₹220–239 crore net in India, ₹500 crore worldwide
item.description: Early day-4 estimates vary widely, from about ₹37 crore to ₹56 crore net.

item.title: OTT this week: Haiwaan, Blind Game, Dilwali Diwali and I'm Game, with Student Of The Year: After Dark next
item.description: A quick list of what streamed over Diwali week, per listings.

item.title: Manisha Bhanwala becomes India's first woman world wrestling champion, winning 59 kg gold in Astana
item.description: She came back from 6-0 down to beat the USA's Abigail Nette 8-6 in the final on 30 October.

item.title: Barbados is certified by WHO for eliminating mother-to-child HIV transmission
item.description: Babies born from 2022 to 2024 had no new HIV infections from their mothers, an independent review found.

item.title: IIT Kharagpur student wins ₹5 lakh Viasat Space for Good India Challenge for AI to dodge space debris
item.description: Adeetya Uppal's idea helps satellites detect threatening debris and plan avoidance moves in seconds.

item.title: A family Doberman helped save a baby: her behaviour led to a heart-condition diagnosis
item.description: Doctors found baby Alexander's heart rate was 280 beats per minute.

item.title: Volunteer dog teams find invasive plants with 75% accuracy in a German study
item.description: Eleven of 12 teams passed the field test, giving a low-cost way to protect local ecosystems.

item.title: UN report: 252 million hectares of habitat are being actively restored across 149 countries
item.description: The Green Climate Fund also had a record year, allocating $3.3 billion to developing countries.

item.title: A beetle absent from Wales for about 60 years has been rediscovered in Pembrokeshire
item.description: Surveyors found short-necked oil beetle larvae at Castlemartin Range after spotting adults there in 2025.

item.title: Coca-Cola's Indian bottling parent files IPO papers; Thums Up and Maaza maker's revenue up 20%
item.description: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers with SEBI for a share sale of up to about 99.7 crore shares. Coca-Cola's stake would fall from 60% to roughly 45%.

item.title: Swiggy renames itself 'Sweety' for Diwali, down to the delivery bags
item.description: For the festive season the food-delivery brand has swapped its name on hoardings, rider jerseys, bags and social handles to celebrate India's love of mithai.

item.title: Meesho closes its ₹186.71 crore Kirana Club deal, adding 4.1 million kirana shops
item.description: The e-commerce company now owns 92.74% of the kirana-network app and its Indian arm, as it pushes into business-to-business trade outside the big cities.

item.title: Ramayana: Part One crosses ₹200 crore gross in India in three days
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's Diwali release, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, is at ₹208 crore gross after its first weekend day, though Hindi screens are running at only 35% full.

item.title: 10 years after demonetisation, cash in circulation is at a record ₹43.46 lakh crore
item.description: The 8 November 2016 note ban was meant to curb black money and push digital payments. UPI exploded, but India's cash habit survived.

item.title: DeepMind's AI agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
item.description: Google DeepMind says human-guided AI agents cut the theoretical cost of forging some RSA signatures by about 1,600x. Modern 2048-bit keys are not affected.

item.title: OYO parent PRISM posts ₹353 crore Q1 profit, but ₹244 crore is a tax credit
item.description: Revenue rose 35% to ₹2,814 crore, yet most of the profit growth comes from a one-off deferred tax credit rather than cash from hotels.

item.title: New-age scorecard: Nykaa profit jumps 207%, Lenskart doubles, Swiggy's loss narrows
item.description: Three consumer-internet names reported July–September results. Two are solidly profitable now, while Swiggy is still losing money but less than last year.

item.title: Delhi's air hits AQI 369 on Diwali eve, with 'severe' forecast for today and tomorrow
item.description: Sixteen of 59 monitoring stations were already in the severe band on Saturday, and experts warn some could cross 450 after tonight's fireworks.

item.title: Agniveers get two more years: Cabinet clears a 'second tour of duty'
item.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said willing Agniveers can stay on and be enrolled as regular soldiers after four or six years if they meet selection criteria.

item.title: Peppermint Robotics raises ₹100 crore to scale robots worldwide
item.description: The Pune and Austin-based startup closed a pre-Series B led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners, roughly $10.5 million.

item.title: Starlink India still hasn't launched, and the ₹8,600 price was test data
item.description: Despite its licence and a Jio distribution deal, Starlink was not taking consumer orders in India as of 6 November.

item.title: LPG check for November: commercial cylinder up ₹10, home cylinder unchanged at ₹942
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices are also unchanged, while jet fuel went up ₹1.30 a litre.

item.title: Axon invests $1.2 billion in drone maker Skydio at a $5.2 billion valuation
item.description: Only $255 million is fresh capital; the rest buys existing shares. Axon becomes Skydio's exclusive public-safety distributor in the US and Canada.

item.title: US sets up Task Force Iron Gate to extend its Iran blockade to land routes
item.description: CENTCOM also disabled another commercial ship in the Gulf of Oman, the 11th since the naval blockade began in July.

item.title: Wall Street ends its worst week in over a year, even after a Friday bounce
item.description: The S&P 500 fell 2.7% for the week and the Nasdaq logged a fourth straight weekly loss, as AI stocks sold off before a partial rebound.

item.title: Reliance jumps 8% on record Q2; Jio Platforms trades 28% above IPO price
item.description: Shares rose on 2 November after Reliance posted record quarterly revenue, EBITDA and profit, taking its market value above ₹17 lakh crore.

item.title: CarTrade leads new-age stocks, up 23% in a week as 54 of 69 tracked names gain
item.description: Foreign buying, Q2 earnings and lower crude helped the Inc42 basket, while the Nifty Midcap 100 rose 5.8%.

item.title: India win rain-hit 2nd ODI by 4 runs (DLS) to lead New Zealand 2-0
item.description: Gurnoor Brar took a career-best 4/30 in Wellington as New Zealand were bowled out for about 134 chasing a revised target.

item.title: Dhinidhi Desinghu becomes the first Indian with two Youth Olympics medals
item.description: She took bronze in the 200m freestyle in Dakar, while Tirthank Pegu won bronze in the 200m butterfly. India's tally is now six.

item.title: Chennaiyin FC thrash defending champions East Bengal 5-3 in ISL goal-fest
item.description: Brison Fernandes scored twice in the first 18 minutes and Irfan Yadwad added two more after the break.

item.title: Leeds beat Tottenham 1-0 with a late Noah Okafor goal
item.description: The substitute's goal ended Spurs' winning run in Saturday's Premier League action.

item.title: Suriya's Scene earns ₹81.5 crore worldwide in two days
item.description: The Diwali action-comedy added ₹20.25 crore net in India on Saturday, up 5.7% on opening day.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero heads for a record $32 million US opening
item.description: It would be the biggest ever US opening for a live-action foreign-language film, ahead of The Cat in the Hat.

item.title: A venomous primate feared extinct for a century is alive in Indonesia
item.description: The Bangka slow loris, last recorded in the 1930s, has been found again, thanks largely to a rescue centre's records.

item.title: 25,000 people from 50 countries help buy a 9,400-acre estate for wildlife
item.description: The Wildlife Trusts raised about £30 million to protect Rothbury Estate in Northumberland, home to a Bronze Age hill fort.

item.title: After a failed first crop, a 57-year-old grew soil-free strawberries and sold ₹44 lakh
item.description: Ketan Sodha, a Mumbai commerce graduate with no farming background, now grows strawberries year-round in Mahabaleshwar.

item.title: A 100-year-old peepal was lifted by a 50-tonne crane and replanted, and it's growing
item.description: Tree-transplantation expert Bharat Sisodia saved an Ahmedabad peepal after it was cut down, moving it nearly two kilometres.

item.title: A Delhi fellowship pays rural performers a stipend to learn theatre
item.description: Bargad's six-month programme pays ₹10,000 a month, rising to ₹15,000 from January 2027, funded by individual donors.

item.title: After 28 years and 31,000 miles on foot, Karl Bushby is home in Hull
item.description: The former paratrooper reached home on 2 November and hugged his mother, Angela, at her gate.

item.title: Angel One overtakes Zerodha to become India's No. 2 broker
item.description: New NSE data for October puts Angel One ahead of Zerodha by active clients for the first time. Groww is still far ahead at No. 1.

item.title: Remember Karbonn? It's back with a ₹11,999 phone and a 7,000mAh battery
item.description: The Indian phone brand that ruled budget shelves a decade ago has returned with the Rebel series, betting on battery life over 5G.

item.title: Ramayana crosses ₹100 crore in India in just two days
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's mega-budget epic has earned about ₹112.9 crore net in India and roughly ₹220 crore worldwide since Thursday's release.

item.title: Mamaearth's parent Honasa grows profit 87% to ₹73 crore
item.description: The D2C beauty company behind Mamaearth posted strong September-quarter numbers, with revenue up 36%.

item.title: OpenAI raises $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
item.description: Bloomberg reports the ChatGPT maker's round could reach about $20 billion — but at a lower price than it was aiming for in September.

item.title: Harsh Jain teases a 'brand new Dream11' by end-December
item.description: After the real-money gaming ban killed its paid contests, Dream11's CEO says a rebuilt app for sports fans is coming.

item.title: ED searches CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over crypto trades sent abroad
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate says the two exchanges allegedly routed crypto derivatives and tokenised stock trades overseas without permission. Delta denies it.

item.title: Burger King India launches a black-bun 'Doomsday Whopper' for Avengers
item.description: As Marvel's official restaurant partner in India, Burger King has rolled out a villain-themed menu from ₹199 ahead of the film's December release.

item.title: Sensex jumps 1,718 points as foreign money pours back into India
item.description: The Sensex and Nifty rose about 2% on Friday and over 8% for the week — their best week in six years.

item.title: India beat Japan 4-1 to win a record 6th Asian Champions Trophy
item.description: Down 0-1 for most of the final, India scored four goals in the last 18 minutes in Mohali to complete a hat-trick of titles.

item.title: Minister says voter ID, not Aadhaar, may be used for benefit payments
item.description: Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh said biometrics and the voter ID number would be the basis for paying beneficiaries. No official policy has been announced yet.

item.title: 67 Israeli MPs back Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form the next government
item.description: President Herzog will announce on Sunday who gets the first chance to form a government after last month's election.

item.title: MakeMyTrip buys majority stake in carpooling app Quick Ride
item.description: The travel giant is entering daily commutes, adding Bengaluru's Quick Ride to a ground-transport stable that already has redBus and Savaari.

item.title: Claude can now read your bank transactions and flag odd charges
item.description: Anthropic's new Personal Finance beta connects bank and card accounts through Plaid. It's US-only for now and read-only.

item.title: Jewellery brand GIVA raises $100 million to open 1,000 stores
item.description: The fine-jewellery startup's round is led by Multiples, just as India heads into Diwali shopping.

item.title: US economy adds 165,000 jobs in October, far above forecasts
item.description: Unemployment fell to 4.1%, a surprise after a rough week for US stocks.

item.title: NSE shares hit a record; exchange now worth over $50 billion
item.description: India's biggest stock exchange touched ₹1,953.95 a share after strong September-quarter profits.

item.title: Tata Punch EV beats Mahindra XEV 9S by just 45 units in October
item.description: India's best-selling electric car race is down to a photo finish, with EV sales up about 76% from last year.

item.title: Turkey ratifies a NATO-style defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
item.description: The Mecca agreement commits the three countries to help each other if one is attacked.

item.title: EloElo raises $80 million from NBCUniversal to grow microdramas
item.description: The parent of Story TV is betting that Indians will pay for bite-sized vertical dramas.

item.title: India hold off Pakistan 3-2 in SAFF Championship opener
item.description: Suhail Bhat scored twice as the defending champions led 3-0 at half-time in Dhaka, before two late Pakistan goals.

item.title: Bengaluru startup Aina unveils a $399 AI ring with its own screen
item.description: The ring tries to guess your next three actions and lets you approve them with a flick.

item.title: Bank of India waives processing fees on home and car loans till March 2027
item.description: Borrowers with a CIBIL score of 725 or more can skip the fee; EV car loans qualify regardless of score.

item.title: Paraguay's president tries to resign after a digital bank collapses
item.description: Congress refused Santiago Peña's resignation and moved towards impeachment after Ueno, used by about 3 million people, failed.

item.title: Cabinet clears ₹2,814 crore to build lithium and nickel plants in India
item.description: The scheme gives a 30% capital subsidy for four processing plants to cut dependence on imports for EV batteries.

item.title: 15-year-old Tanvi Patri wins India's first Youth Olympics women's singles silver
item.description: She pushed world junior champion Zhang Yi Xin to 26-24 in the deciding game of the final in Dakar.

item.title: US Justice Department sets up a 'Super Intelligence' task force
item.description: The new team will go after foreign states, criminal groups and fraudsters who misuse advanced AI.

item.title: MobiKwik gets an RBI lending licence, eyes ₹5,000 crore in loans
item.description: The fintech's subsidiary can now lend directly as an NBFC, starting within three to six months.

item.title: India go for 2-0 against New Zealand in today's 2nd ODI
item.description: After Virat Kohli's 74 sealed the rain-hit opener, the series moves to Wellington.

item.title: Diwali weekend on OTT: Haiwaan, The Vvaan and Last Man in Tower
item.description: Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, Sidharth Malhotra and Manoj Bajpayee lead this weekend's streaming picks.

item.title: Seabird colony wiped out by bird flu bounces back to 756 terns
item.description: At England's Pagham Harbour, sandwich terns have returned in big numbers after vanishing in 2022.

item.title: These Tamil Nadu villages skip Diwali crackers every year — to protect bats
item.description: In villages across the state, people have chosen quiet Diwalis for generations so fruit bats roosting nearby aren't scared away.

item.title: Critically endangered pangolin caught on camera near Shillong
item.description: A Wildlife Institute of India camera trap recorded a Chinese pangolin in forests on the edge of the city.

item.title: Brazil expands Pantanal park, home to the world's most jaguars
item.description: The protected area in the world's largest tropical wetland has grown by 185 square miles.

item.title: Barbados stops HIV passing from mothers to babies, WHO confirms
item.description: No baby in Barbados got HIV from their mother between 2022 and 2024.

item.title: This Maharashtra village now makes 500 litres of drinking water from air
item.description: A machine built with CSIR-IICT scientists pulls moisture out of the air for children in drought-prone Washim.

item.title: Nature is being restored at the fastest rate ever recorded, says UN
item.description: About 252 million hectares across 149 countries are now under active restoration, a UNEP report finds.

item.title: A Gurugram student built a free app that measures light pollution from a phone photo
item.description: Class 12 student Suhani Gupta's SkyQi has collected readings from 490+ people in 63 countries.

item.title: Blinkit Ambulance will now charge ₹2,500 for non-emergency trips
item.description: Emergency rides stay free. Routine trips like check-ups and hospital-to-home transfers will now be paid.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal hits back at doctors over his ‘Temple’ wearable
item.description: Doctors called the ₹85,000 brain-tracking gadget a scam. Goyal says the science will prove them wrong.

item.title: OpenAI could go public in 2027
item.description: The ChatGPT maker's president says the company could be ready for a stock market listing next year.

item.title: A viral video got a PVR juice counter shut in Bengaluru
item.description: A moviegoer alleged that used cups were being reused. Food safety officials inspected — and shut the counter.

item.title: India set for a ₹1 lakh crore Dhanteras
item.description: Traders expect record shopping today — led by gold and silver, even though gold is about 20% costlier than last year.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
item.description: After 23 years and a record 146 goals, the 41-year-old is done playing for Portugal — but he isn't leaving Al-Nassr.

item.title: Democrats win both houses of the US Congress
item.description: In Tuesday's midterm elections, Democrats took control of the House and the Senate — the first time in 20 years a Republican president has lost both.

item.title: Wall Street loses $2.5 trillion in a single day
item.description: The Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025, as AI and chip stocks crashed.

item.title: Tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire, several after hitting mines. Oil crossed $100 a barrel.

item.title: Iran lets Indian ships through the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Indian vessels are exempt from Iran's shipping restrictions in the world's most important oil route — though they still pay a fee.

item.title: Delhi's air turns "severe" before Diwali
item.description: The capital's average AQI crossed 450 this week, and stricter GRAP-II curbs are now in force across the NCR.

item.title: Drone-delivery startup Zipline raises $1.5 billion
item.description: Its valuation has nearly tripled in about ten months, and Walmart is adding about 300 more drone-delivery locations.

item.title: Google plans a $17 billion AI data center in Wyoming
item.description: It will be Google's first in the state, powered largely by a giant fuel-cell plant.

item.title: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California over teen feeds law
item.description: The law limits autoplay and personalised feeds for users under 16. The companies say it breaks free-speech rules.

item.title: OpenAI's new AI found 81 serious Firefox bugs
item.description: A cybersecurity model for approved researchers is finding and helping fix software holes at a scale humans could not.

item.title: Airtel's profit jumps 24% as users pay more
item.description: Bharti Airtel's quarterly profit rose to ₹10,710 crore, helped by higher revenue per user.

item.title: LIC's profit rises 20% to ₹12,076 crore
item.description: India's biggest insurer had a strong September quarter, though new first-year premiums dipped slightly.

item.title: Microsoft pulls back, AI cloud stocks tumble
item.description: Microsoft passed on a bigger deal with Nscale and is tightening oversight of its AI cloud partners. Their shares fell sharply.

item.title: Palantir's revenue nearly doubles to $2.31 billion
item.description: The data and AI software company had its first $2 billion quarter and raised its outlook for the year.

item.title: India storm into the Asian Champions Trophy final
item.description: The defending champions beat South Korea 8-1 in the semi-final in Punjab to reach a record seventh final.

item.title: TRAI proposes separate licences for satellite internet
item.description: The telecom regulator wants satellite players under a new set of rules — and not selling directly to customers.

item.title: 40 US towns vote NO to AI data centers
item.description: Voters rejected new data-center projects, angry about power bills and pollution.

item.title: AMD plans $11 billion in AI acquisitions
item.description: A filing shows the chipmaker wants to buy World Labs and inference-chip startup Taalas.

item.title: Defence startup Shield AI buys Echodyne for $5.3 billion
item.description: The AI drone-pilot maker is buying a radar company and raising $2.5 billion at a $28.8 billion valuation.

item.title: Grubhub owner Wonder files to go public
item.description: Marc Lore's food company — which also owns Blue Apron — has confidentially filed for a US IPO.

item.title: India's services sector picks up speed in October
item.description: The HSBC India Services PMI rose to 55.8, showing faster growth in businesses like IT, banking, travel and retail.

item.title: Deepti Sharma in the race for ICC Player of the Month
item.description: The all-rounder was shortlisted after a match-winning show against Zimbabwe.

item.title: What to watch this weekend on OTT
item.description: Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game, Netflix's Dilwali Diwali and a new season of Black Doves lead this week's releases.

item.title: Joyalukkas sets aside ₹100 crore for charity
item.description: The jewellery brand will fund homes, girls' education, elderly care and medical help.

item.title: Tata Trusts gave ₹1,556 crore — and plans up to 50 hospitals
item.description: The Trusts want a network of not-for-profit hospitals where those who can pay help cover those who can't.

item.title: Gene therapy helps blind patients see objects again
item.description: In a new trial, people blinded by an inherited eye disease could detect and find everyday objects.

item.title: A short truce in Ukraine got nearly 800 people to safety
item.description: A six-day ceasefire in the town of Oleshky let aid in and people out. More peace talks are planned next week.

item.title: Two teen brothers rescue a family from a flooded home
item.description: When emergency crews couldn't get through, they paddled in with a kayak and a paddleboard.

item.title: 8 tiger cubs bring new hope to a Rajasthan sanctuary
item.description: It's the first successful tiger breeding recorded at Kailadevi in nearly 30 years.

item.title: Saffron blooms on barren land in Ladakh
item.description: A pilot farm in Leh flowered in under a month and gave 22 grams of saffron in four days.

item.title: Bengal's "Foodman" runs 20+ free study centres for children
item.description: A college professor gives children free meals and free coaching across West Bengal.

item.title: This Bhopal café swaps your trash for a meal
item.description: Bring plastic, paper or household waste — walk out with food. 45 tonnes recycled so far.

item.title: IIT Bombay's free tool warns farmers of drought 4 weeks early
item.description: KrishiDrought uses satellites and AI to forecast dry soil for every district in India.

item.title: Students fill a football field with food for families in need
item.description: A New Jersey high school collected more than 250,000 pounds of food in one drive.
